summary: Iter 47 — BOTH bug fixes VERIFIED end-to-end. (1) AUTO-REVIEW ON STUDENT SUBMIT: 5/5 new tests + regressions PASS — text file submit, resubmit (with count increment + field reset), business_questionnaire, milestone-override template precedence, and submit-on-behalf regression all trigger AI feedback within ~90s. (2) MAGIC-LINK AUTO-AUTH: 12/12 new backend tests PASS + 3/3 Playwright UI scenarios PASS — /api/auth/magic-link handles missing/empty/nonexistent/expired/deleted-user cases correctly; send-feedback CTA appends ?auth=<magic_...>; token security bounds verified (30-day TTL, unpredictable hex, bound to single user); UI flow strips ?auth= after exchange, no login prompt, real GPT-5.2 reply received.

minor.issue: assignment_id and cohort_id must be passed as QUERY-STRING params (not multipart form) because they lack Form() annotations, unlike POST /api/milestones/{id}/submit-on-behalf which uses Form(...). Not a functional bug (frontend already sends them as query params in DirectSubmit.js:409-414), but this inconsistency between the two endpoints is a footgun for future contributors and tests. Recommend adding Form() annotations to submit_milestone for parity.

integration_issues.issue: When a user already has a stored session token and hits /coach-max/{id}?auth=<other_magic>, the AuthContext correctly SHORT-CIRCUITS the exchange (`if (magic && !getStoredToken())`) — but as a side effect it ALSO skips `history.replaceState` so the `?auth=<other_magic>` stays visible in the address bar. This is not a security hole (the other magic is never used or stored) but it does leave the URL cluttered and shareable-with-token. Recommend moving the URL-strip out of the exchange branch and always running it whenever `?auth=` is present.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In server.py submit_milestone (line ~2892), promote `assignment_id` and `cohort_id` from bare defaults to `Form(...)` for API parity with submit_milestone_on_behalf. Frontend already passes them as query params so this is non-breaking if handled with Union or by keeping the query fallback.

OPTIONAL: In AuthContext.js line 44-67, move the `history.replaceState` URL-strip OUTSIDE the `if (magic && !getStoredToken())` block so the `?auth=` param is always stripped whenever it's present, even for already-authenticated users. This prevents a stale magic from lingering in the address bar for shareable/bookmarkable pages.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3025-3035 — auto-review trigger is correctly placed AFTER the DB insert/update and correctly extracts week_number + effective_template (milestone override → assignment fallback → None). Precedence proven by test 4.
server.py:2971-2977 — effective_template resolution correctly strips whitespace and falls through empty strings. LGTM.

server.py:1175-1186 _create_session_token_for_user — `magic_` prefix + uuid4().hex (32 hex chars) → strong entropy; expires_at stored as ISO string with UTC tz; purpose='magic_link' distinguishes these from normal sessions.

server.py:1189-1212 magic_link_login — correctly deletes expired tokens (prevents indefinite growth), returns HTTP 401 for both invalid AND expired (no info leak on which is which), returns 404 only when user was deleted (edge case).
server.py:5540-5564 send_feedback_to_student — magic token created BEFORE building coach_max_url, embedded in link. Same treatment in generate_feedback_pdf (5653). Consistent.

AuthContext.js:46-67 — magic exchange runs BEFORE the /me check (correct order). Short-circuits with `if (magic && !getStoredToken())` — safe. Fallthrough on error means the user gets the standard login flow if the magic is invalid.

MINOR: AuthContext.js:60 — `history.replaceState` only runs inside the exchange branch. If the user is already authenticated (`getStoredToken()` non-null), the ?auth= param stays in the URL. Recommend moving the strip outside the branch.
